description: List requests for a specific Zendesk organization. Use when you need to retrieve all requests associated with a particular organization. This action returns request details including subject, status, priority, requester, and timestamps. Pagination is available for large result sets.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing organization requests.

organization_id.description: Numeric ID of the organization whose requests to retrieve. Must be a non-null integer; cast to int if sourced from tools that return it as a string. Do not pass null (skip the call if organization_id is null). Obtain from zendesk.get_all_zendesk_organizations or zendesk.create_zendesk_organization; never derive from organization name.
organization_id.human_parameter_description: Enter the numeric ID of the organization whose requests you want to list. You can copy this from the organization's page or from a previous search or list.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-100). Limited to first 100 pages or 10,000 records total. For larger datasets, use cursor pagination instead.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of results you want to view. Start at 1 and increase to browse through more requests. Limited to page 100.
page.title: Page

page_after.description: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'after_cursor' or 'next' link.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the next set of results in cursor-based pagination.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's 'before_cursor' or 'prev' link.
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the previous set of results in cursor-based pagination.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of requests per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use this for large datasets instead of page/per_page.
page_size.human_parameter_description: Number of requests per page using cursor-based pagination. Recommended for accessing more than 10,000 records.
page_size.title: Page Size

per_page.description: Number of requests per page (max 100). Note: page * per_page cannot exceed 10,000. Set to 100 for large accounts to minimize requests before client-side filtering.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many requests to show on each page. You can choose up to 100; smaller numbers can make pages load faster.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort_by.description: Field to sort requests by. Options are 'updated_at' or 'created_at'.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Choose the field to sort the requests list by - either when they were last updated or when they were created.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order direction. Options are 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' if not specified.
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose the direction of sorting - ascending (A-Z, oldest first) or descending (Z-A, newest first).
sort_order.title: Sort Order
